title: FRED Global Central Bank Policy and Yield Curves
description: Policy-rate and sovereign-yield signals for the G4 central banks via FRED. Tracks US Fed Funds effective rate, Fed target upper bound, US 2Y/10Y Treasuries, 10Y-2Y and 10Y-3M spreads (recession indicators), ECB deposit facility rate, Germany/Japan/UK 10Y sovereigns. Each row carries a regime flag (TIGHTENING/EASING/STEADY for policy rates; NORMAL/FLAT/INVERTED for curves; RISING/FALLING/STABLE for long yields) and an investment thesis keyed to the regime (yield-curve inversion → defensive rotation XLU/XLP + long USD; tightening → short bonds TLT, long USD; easing → long duration + risk-on). 30-day change is reported in basis points for operator scanning. Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
